law: REGISTRATION of E-Q19 — the docket round (ORCH-R20 lane T11-b2): the FIRST consumer-driven pricing target. A qthe-backed task-arbitration docket (the second live consumer the frontier doc names as the hierarchical build's trigger) priced against the standard inbox under three loads. Committed BEFORE ANY RUN; arms, floors, metrics and verdict rules frozen; honest null = crown jewel. The kernel is NEVER touched and never transcribed: arm A runs the REAL qthe.mjs tick (import), the docket is a policy consumer over the substrate — LAYER 2 prices the workload, LAYER 0 does the physics.

provenance_of_the_question.frontier_doc: docs/FRONTIER-DECISION.md: 'The trigger for the hierarchical build: a second live consumer.' The docket is that consumer; this experiment prices what it changes.
provenance_of_the_question.r19_close: docs/discussions/2026-10-18-orch-r19-report.md: 'Next round candidates: the fleet's asks (watch continues), or the first consumer-driven pricing target.'
provenance_of_the_question.layer0_hooks: qthe.mjs: Abstain contributes 0 to the real accumulator (the debounce); nextD saturates at min(d+1,63) (the aging cap); the wormhole table is written ONLY by Abstain cells at slot = current d, read live (R2/R3/R4) — the deferred-task recovery channel, the E-Q1 mechanism verbatim.
provenance_of_the_question.eq14_boundary: E-Q14 B autopsy: delivery robust, WHO lost under congestion — the drift regime this design's wormhole channel inherits; pre-registered below as the known boundary.

design_frozen.grid: 32x32 FIXED, T=2000 epochs, seeds 81001..81010 (10 trials per arm x load).
design_frozen.substrate: the REAL kernel: makeSubstrate + tick(sub) every epoch (arm A), tau NEVER changed by tick (R3); tasks are cells; the plane is the docket.
design_frozen.tasks: {id, source, p0 in [1..62], cargo c in [8..15]}. Submission stamps cell = pack(ATTRACT, p0) at a position inside the SOURCE'S HOME REGION (agents submit from where they stand — the agent-fleet regime; a scatter-flood defeats locality and is pre-registered as the known boundary, BOUNDARY-MAP culture). Homes: L1/L2 4 sources -> 4 quadrants (16x16 each); L3 4 normal sources -> three strips + flood source F home = one 16x16 quadrant. Position = deterministic rejection sample (mulberry32(id)) within home, free-cell scan spiral on collision.
design_frozen.claimers: 8 anchors (L1/L2) or 4 (L3), spread >= 8 toroidal-Chebyshev, each with cargo affinity c_j = 8..15 distinct. Claimers are NOT cells (they query the plane; they never write it) — the substrate stays a pure task plane.
design_frozen.claim_rule: per epoch: tick first (arm A / A-off), then claimers in fixed order, ONE claim each: (1) LOCAL: among the 8 Moore-8 neighbors of the anchor on the post-tick plane, cells holding live ATTRACT tasks; claim max current d; ties -> older submission, then lower id (fully deterministic). (2) ELSE WORMHOLE (arm A only): hit = table.read(c_j); if the occupant cell holds a live deferred (ABSTAIN) task, claim it (level='wormhole', resonance receipted). (3) Else no claim. Claimed task: cell -> Ground pack(0,0), serve receipt {epoch, taskId, source, claimer, level, dAtServe, p0, latency}. Capacity-matched: the baseline serves the same per-load claim count per epoch.

arms.B_baseline: the standard inbox: global FIFO + static priority heap on p0 (never ages), ties FIFO by submission. Same arrival stream, same per-epoch claim capacity.
arms.A_docket: the full docket: real kernel tick every epoch (Moore-8 pressure evolves d; saturation min(d+1,63)), local-view claims, Abstain invisibility in the real accumulator (the debounce), wormhole escalation for deferred tasks.
arms.A_static: attribution arm: the docket policy with d FROZEN at p0 (no tick; tau still flips per the load model; no table writes -> no wormhole claims). Isolates the physics/aging contribution.
arms.A_off: attribution arm: full ticks but wormholes:false (the table never written; deferred tasks invisible remotely). Isolates the wormhole channel (mechanism check F2).

loads.L1_uniform: 4 sources x 1.5 tasks/epoch, p0 uniform [1..62], C=8. Utilization 75% (healthy regime). Parity + priority fidelity measured here.
loads.L2_flapping: source 0's tasks are ALL flappers: tau flips ATTRACT<->ABSTAIN with period 8 (phase = id mod 8); on every flip back to ATTRACT, p0 is RE-DRAWN from [48..62] (the gaming model: re-boost before sinking). Sources 1-3 normal. C=8. The baseline heap suffers re-boost monopolization; the docket's debounce (Abstain = 0 in acc) opens claim windows for stable tasks.
loads.L3_flood: flood source F submits 3 tasks/epoch at p0=62 into ITS home quadrant (50% of volume), 3 normal sources at 1/epoch into their strips. C=4 (overload 150% — the starvation regime; capacity is part of the LOAD, matched across arms).

metrics.fairness: Jain index over per-source served counts; maxShare = max source fraction of served.
metrics.starvation: starveRate = tasks never served by T_end, split by flapper status where applicable (stableStarve vs flapStarve); unserved-age telemetry at T_end.
metrics.latency: submission epoch -> claim epoch over served tasks; p50/p99 (corpus convention: numeric sort, UPPER middle index floor(n/2)).
metrics.priority_fidelity: Spearman(p0, serve order) over served tasks per (arm, load) — the docket must degrade gracefully, not ignore priority.
metrics.mechanism_telemetry: wormholeClaims/totalClaims (A only; A-off must be 0 — floor F2); saturationFrac = fraction of tasks whose cell reached d=63 (the aging cap receipt); defer-visibility: claims of deferred tasks by level.
metrics.plane: final plane hash per run (the determinism receipt).

hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H1_flapping_debounce: LIVES iff median(A L2 Jain) >= 0.80 AND median(B L2 Jain) < 0.65 AND median(A L2 stableStarve) <= 0.5 x median(B L2 stableStarve). DIES otherwise with mechanism autopsy. Registered death candidates: (a) defer windows too short relative to claim cadence (period-8 flappers visible 4 of 8 epochs — enough to keep winning views); (b) re-boost band [48..62] outranks everything in every view it appears in, defer or not.
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H2_flood_cap: LIVES iff median(A L3 maxShare) <= 0.40 AND median(B L3 maxShare) >= 0.70. DIES otherwise. Registered death candidate: claimer anchors adjacent to F's quadrant drain F's backlog no faster than F arrives (share -> arrival-capped 0.75 anyway — the spatial cap fails if anchors cluster near F).
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H3_uniform_parity: LIVES iff median(A L1 p50) <= 1.15 x median(B L1 p50). An honest null is tolerated by C10's verdict ONLY as a reported cost; if parity fails, C10's scope must name the latency price.
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H4_priority_fidelity: advisory (reported, not gating): median(A L1 Spearman) >= 0.25 — graceful degradation, not priority blindness.
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.C10_verdict: C10 ('a qthe-docket reduces starvation and source-monopolization under source-local flapping and flooding loads versus a FIFO+static-priority inbox, at parity on uniform load') LIVES iff H1 AND H2 AND H3. Attribution (A vs A-static = physics/aging; A vs A-off = wormhole channel) reported LAYER 1, never folded into C10's verdict.
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.prediction_receipt: Pre-run point predictions (the P1 discipline): B L3 maxShare ~0.75 (arrival-capped); A L3 maxShare ~0.30-0.40; B L2 stableStarve ~0.5+ (re-boost monopolization at 75% util is partial — revise: with C=8 > arrivals 6, the heap drains; monopolization shows as LATENCY skew, so H1's starve rule may read ~0 for both — the Jain clause and p99 latency carry the signal; if both starve ~0 the H1 starve clause is SATISFIED VACUOUSLY only if Jain+latency clauses hold — amended verdict rule: H1 LIVES iff Jain clause AND (starve clause OR A p99 <= 0.7 x B p99 on stable tasks)); A L1 Spearman ~0.5-0.8 vs B ~0.9+; A L1 saturationFrac < 0.05 (healthy load, few clusters saturate); A L3 saturationFrac ~0.3+ (F clusters age to the cap).

floors_frozen.EQ19_F0: determinism 2x fresh construction: byte-identical serve logs + final plane hashes, 120/120 runs (4 arms x 3 loads x 10 seeds), else VOID.
floors_frozen.EQ19_F1: kernel-real by construction: arm A imports qthe.mjs and calls tick() — no transcription exists in this experiment; receipted in the runner's import line.
floors_frozen.EQ19_F2: A-off wormhole claims == 0 across all runs (the OFF control is real), else the OFF arm is broken, LOUD.
floors_frozen.EQ19_F3: capacity match: claims offered per epoch identical across arms per load (8/8/4), receipted per run.
floors_frozen.EQ19_F4: arrival-stream identity: all arms consume the SAME seeded arrival stream per (load, seed) — asserted by comparing the first/last task ids and counts per source, else VOID.

consult.planned: one Seed-2.0-mini ATTACK-briefed call on this registration (the E-Q17/E-Q18 discipline: attacks on the design, dispositions receipted as pre-run amendments, AS-SAID, sealed to situations/e_q19_design_attack.jsonl). Budget $0.01.
consult.law: no amendment after the first data row exists (the pricing-first law); amendments are append-only and pre-run only.

endpoints: per (arm, load, seed): served, perSourceServed, jain, maxShare, starveRate (+stable/flap split on L2), p50/p99 latency (+p99 stable on L2), spearman, wormholeClaims, saturationFrac, finalPlaneHash, determinism rerun ok, capacity+arrival assertions
attribution table: A vs A-static vs A-off on L2/L3 (physics and wormhole deltas)
verdict block: H1 (amended rule verbatim) / H2 / H3 / H4 each LIVES/DIES; C10 verdict; mechanism autopsy candidates checked off or ruled out

amendments_pre_run.consult: situations/e_q19_design_attack.jsonl (ByteDance/Seed-2.0-mini, ATTACK-briefed, 6 attacks, $0.001147, 36.1s, AS-SAID, sealed pre-run — no data row existed)
amendments_pre_run.EQ19_AM1_from_A1_accepted_in_part: A-static is receipted as the COARSE no-tick bundle (aging AND wormholes both absent — without tick there are no table writes). The ranking function is IDENTICAL across arms (max current d, ties age-then-id); what differs is d's provenance (evolved vs frozen-at-p0) — A1's 'ranking function changes' framing is refuted, but its bundling point stands: A vs A-static prices the bundle, and the per-run telemetry (wormholeClaims, saturationFrac, dAtServe) enables post-hoc decomposition. The clean single-channel isolation remains A vs A-off.
amendments_pre_run.EQ19_AM2_from_A2_ACCEPTED_the_real_defec: The addressing mismatch is real: the table is written at slot = the deferred task's CURRENT d (kernel law, qthe.mjs tick() Abstain branch) while claimers read slot = c_j in [8..15]; under L2's re-boost band [48..62] the channel is expected to carry ~0 claims. KEPT DELIBERATELY KERNEL-FAITHFUL — no policy rewrites of the plane, no claimer slot-scanning beyond the registered cargo query. Consequences registered: (a) the wormhole channel is NOT claimed to drive H1/H2 — the debounce (LAYER 0: Abstain contributes 0 to acc) and view locality carry them; (b) the channel's expected quiet IS the consumer-side restatement of E-Q14's WHO-loss under d-drift, receipted against BOUNDARY-MAP; (c) F2 amended: A-off wormholeClaims == 0 AND A's wormholeClaims receipted at whatever volume including ~0.
amendments_pre_run.A3_REFUTED_with_clarification: Load parity means STREAM identity (F4: arrival, flip and re-boost events identical across arms), not identical internal visibility — the flapper's invisibility while deferred IS the treatment under test, not a confound. served/starved are defined identically across arms (claimed by T_end / not). The re-boost re-stamp applies to BOTH arms (B's heap entry re-enters at the new p0; A's cell re-stamps).
amendments_pre_run.A4_REFUTED_with_guard: Stale table entries are already rejected by the claim rule's occupancy guard (the occupant cell must CURRENTLY hold a live ABSTAIN task) — the E-Q14 log-order-matching lesson applied. Telemetry added: ghostReads counter per run, split by reject reason (notAbstain / notLive), so addressing-misses (AM2) and staleness-misses are separable.
amendments_pre_run.EQ19_AM5_from_A5_accepted_in_part: Metric interpretation amended: report BOTH Spearman(p0, serve order) and Spearman(dAtServe, serve order). The docket's own ranking fidelity (dAtServe version, expected >= 0.9) and the departure from static priority (p0 version, H4 advisory at >= 0.25) are DIFFERENT quantities; the gap between them is the aging price, receipted as such. Low p0-fidelity is a measured cost, not 'blindness' — A5's interpretation point accepted, its 'metric misalignment' framing refuted.
amendments_pre_run.A6_REFUTED_with_clarification: F0 is WITHIN-(arm, load, seed) determinism: each of the 120 (arm, load, seed) cells runs twice from fresh construction and must produce byte-identical serve logs and final plane hashes — 120 PAIRS, never cross-arm identity (cross-arm difference is the experiment's point). The load model's cell rewrites (flips, re-stamps) are seeded and stream-identical across arms (F4).
amendments_pre_run.EQ19_AM6_IMPLEMENTATION_TIME_PRE_RUN: Self-caught while writing the runner, BEFORE the first execution — no data row existed; this amendment and the runner land in the same commit, amendment first. (a) L2 capacity 8->4: at C=8 the heap drains and monopolization cannot appear in served counts; the claim's regime is overload. L1 stays C=8 (the parity/fidelity regime). (b) L1/L2 positions quadrant-homes -> WHOLE-GRID SCATTER: with sovereign homes, view locality alone protects stable tasks and the debounce the load exists to test becomes untestable; L2 is the open co-working regime. L3 KEEPS source-local homes (the flood cap is spatial BY CLAIM; C10's scope is thereby 'flapping (spatially mixed) and source-local flooding'). (c) H1 re-keyed — Jain demoted to telemetry (between-source equality is blind to the stable-vs-flapper split that IS the signal): H1 LIVES iff med(A stableStarve) <= 0.5 x med(B stableStarve) AND med(A stableP99) <= 0.7 x med(B stableP99); the registration's vacuous-starve hedge is superseded by this rule. (d) grid 32x32 -> 64x64 (the E-Q14 canonical size): the plane must hold the overload backlog (worst-case live ~4000 <= 4096; freeCell's LOUD throw is the built-in floor); homes = 32x32 quadrants. (f) B-local arm ADDED (nearest-live-task greedy to the anchor, ties max current p0 then age then id — the naive spatial baseline): H3 re-keyed to B-local (a spatial substrate's parity is measured against the spatial alternative); B-global stays as the reference column and its gap is receipted as THE LOCALITY PRICE. (g) L3 verdict keyed at the PRE-OVERFLOW CHECKPOINT epoch 500 (F's live backlog ~= its home capacity there): H2 LIVES iff med(A maxShare@500) <= 0.40 AND med(B maxShare@500) >= 0.70; the T_end number is the registered backlog-bounded erosion receipt (size the substrate to the backlog). (h) task.cargo is ledger telemetry only (vestigial from draft 1; no mechanism reads it). (i) the re-boost re-stamp law: flip-back writes pack(1, newP0) — emergent consequence REGISTERED AS PREDICTION: under saturation the re-boost resets aging while age breaks d-ties at 63, so the gamer's periodic boost is a self-inflicted FIFO penalty.
amendments_pre_run.EQ19_AM7_POST_LOUD_THROW_PRE_RUN: The AM6(d) floor FIRED EXACTLY AS REGISTERED — freeCell threw 'plane full (live=4096)' during the first L2 execution; NO data row existed (no results file, no chain row; console lines only, unsealed). The E-Q17-AM3 precedent applies: amendment after a LOUD feasibility throw, before any sealed result. The expanding view (AM6(e)) is SUPERSEDED — its reset-to-1 law reintroduced the blind-spot pathology in backlog regimes: once backlog builds, every anchor's r=1 view is full, the radius never expands, and 72 of 4096 cells receive all claims while arrivals elsewhere starve until the plane fills. THE TILED LAW: the plane is partitioned into C jurisdiction tiles (C=4: the four 32x32 quadrants — ALIGNED with L3's source homes, so the flood cap is structural; C=8: eight 32x16 half-quadrants); anchor j lives in tile j and claims the best ATTRACT task in its WHOLE tile (max current d, ties age then id) — exhaustive by construction (every task is in exactly one jurisdiction; no blind spots possible), local-first, deterministic, one claim per anchor per epoch; the wormhole escalation fires when the anchor's TILE is drained of claimable ATTRACT work (A only; the cargo-slot query and live-ABSTAIN guard unchanged); the anchor spread constraint is dropped (one anchor per tile; the anchor's in-tile position serves as the B-local reference point).
